data.narrative:
Ark Robotics is a seed-stage company in the Defense & Security sector. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 private companies and 2 public entities operating in robotics and autonomous systems for defense applications. The private peer set includes UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic, among others.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach given available data. Analysis of 3 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage peers—UFORCE (Seed, $1.0B), Singularity (Series A, $400M), and NODA AI (Series A, $125M)—yields a median valuation of $400M, with the peer range spanning $125M to $1.0B. This method directly informs the implied valuation.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $340M to $460M, with a median of $400M. Key uncertainties include the limited sample size (one method, three peers) and the stage heterogeneity within the comp set, where one peer is at seed while two occupy Series A. The wide peer range ($125M to $1.0B) reflects material dispersion in how investors are pricing defense robotics companies at this stage. Refinement of this range would benefit from additional revenue or funding-round data, which are not available in the current dataset.
